cs.t: I feel like such initiatives miss one obvious target - the well heeled tech savvy user  (who quite often is also privacy minded) and wants the latest. At the price point they are selling a  Snapdragon 7 device, I can get a Snapdragon 8 Elite phone from the market quite easily. Now I am happy to pay more because of what they stand for but I don't see them selling a model that features the latest and greatest + the privacy focus. Surely the latest hardware and privacy/environmental responsibility are not mutually exclusive. I change my phone every 4-5 years on average so I try to not contribute to the landfills but I do want the latest when I buy.
